_comment: Board wiring data — the Autonomous equivalent of a Linux DTS / Android BoardConfig. Adding a board = one entry here, no code change. Loaded by board.py into typed BoardProfile structs. `match` = lowercased substrings tested against /proc/device-tree/model (first match wins, file order); keep them non-overlapping. `led.transport` = spi|pwm. `default_board` is used when the model is unknown/unreadable.

raspberry_pi_cm4._comment: Compute Module 4 — the device-tree model is 'Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4 Rev 1.1', which contains no 'pi 4' substring, so it needs its own matcher. Reachy Mini Wireless ships on this board. led/button values are inherited from raspberry_pi_4 (same BCM2711 pinout) and are UNVERIFIED: no CM4 device declares `light` or a GPIO button yet. Verify before wiring either on this board.
